salary_details.details: The compensation package may include applicable IDA, HRA or accommodation, cafeteria benefits, Performance Related Pay, PF, gratuity, pension, medical benefits, insurance and other benefits according to POWERGRID rules.

selection_process: OBC (NCL) / SC / ST / PwBD against reserved vacancies 30%
There is no separate POWERGRID written examination for this recruitment. Selection is based on the candidate's valid GATE 2026 score followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview.
Candidates will be shortlisted category-wise for Group Discussion and Personal Interview on the basis of their normalized marks out of 100 in the corresponding GATE 2026 paper.
Group Discussion carries 3% weightage and does not have separate qualifying marks.
Candidates may participate in Group Discussion and Interview in either Hindi or English.
Final appointment is subject to the candidate being found medically fit according to POWERGRID's prescribed pre-employment medical standards.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must apply online through the Career section of the POWERGRID website.

Upload the prescribed documents.

Submit the application on or before 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is POWERGRID Engineer Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: POWERGRID Engineer Trainee Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Power Grid Corporation of India Limited for Engineer Trainee positions in Electrical, Civil and Computer Science disciplines through GATE 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in POWERGRID Engineer Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 319 vacancies have been notified, including 250 Electrical, 48 Civil and 21 Computer Science posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for POWERGRID Engineer Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the applicable application fee is 18 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. When did the POWERGRID Engineer Trainee application start?
faq.answer: Online registration started on 03 November 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for POWERGRID Engineer Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a full-time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering degree in the prescribed branch with the required marks and must have qualified GATE 2026 in the corresponding paper.

faq.question: Q6. Which GATE paper is required for POWERGRID Engineer Trainee 2026?
faq.answer: Electrical candidates need GATE EE, Civil candidates need GATE CE and Computer Science candidates need GATE CS.

faq.question: Q7. What is the POWERGRID Engineer Trainee age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on 31 December 2025, subject to applicable category-wise relaxation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs.500 for applicable candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and eligible departmental candidates are exempt as specified in the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q9. What is the POWERGRID Engineer Trainee salary?
faq.answer: During one-year training, the initial Basic Pay is Rs.40,000 in the Rs.40,000-1,40,000 IDA scale. After successful training, candidates are absorbed as Engineer in E2 scale of Rs.50,000-1,60,000.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for POWERGRID Engineer Trainee?
faq.answer: Selection is based on GATE 2026 score with 85% weightage, Group Discussion with 3% weightage and Personal Interview with 12% weightage, followed by medical examination.
